name: Hiiragi Mana
source:
The heroine of the story.

She is a nurse who was hired by the protagonist's school, and is the fiancée of Hojo Motonori.

She has a compassionate personality and quickly becomes the school's Madonna, the object of admiration for the male students.

She is always concerned about the protagonist, who is hardworking but clumsy.

[Translated from [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/hoken/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
